rows.title: Germinal products notifications have their own Upload documents page
rows.detail: Germinal products is its own set in the animals frontend, and each of its pages is a copy of the matching live animals page, taken once that page has been built. Upload documents is one of the germinal set's pages: only Additional details, the CPH number and the permanent address are left out of it. A trader working on a germinal products notification needs the same place to attach an ITAHC and the other documents a consignment needs, with the same guidance, the same four fields, the same virus-scan statuses, listing, download and removal, and with that notification's documents kept apart from any live animals notification's. The germinal data fields list names no germinal-specific document fields, so the copy asks exactly what the live animals page asks.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification, the overview's 'Upload documents' task opens a page headed 'Upload documents' with the caption 'Documents', the fields Document reference, Document type, Date of issue and Attachment in that order inside a 'File upload' card with a 'Save and add another' button, and 'Save and continue', 'Save and return to overview' and 'Cancel and return to overview' at the foot of the page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 2, 3; repo:frontend src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents)

On a germinal products notification, the Upload documents page opens with 'You must attach an ITAHC if this consignment requires one. If you do not have it now, you can add it later. All documents should be uploaded before the consignment arrives at the UK port. Documents must be in English and you must upload all pages.', then 'Other documents you may need to attach include:' with the bullets 'import licences or authorisations' and 'commercial documents or invoices', and an expander 'Check which additional documents you must upload' holding the additional-documents table. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 2, 3; repo:frontend src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents)

On a germinal products notification, the Document type list offers 'Select one' and then, in this order, 'ITAHC (Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate)', 'Other veterinary certificate / veterinary declaration', 'Self-declaration', 'Journey log', 'Import permit / authorisation', 'CITES permit/certificate', 'Air waybill', 'Sea waybill', 'Rail waybill', 'Bill of lading', 'Commercial invoice', 'Packing list / species list' and 'Other supporting documents'. (confluence:6497338582 §Germinal Data Elements; repo:frontend src/server/app/services/document-types)

On a germinal products notification, the Attachment field's hint reads 'Your file must be:' with the bullets 'files that are smaller than 50MB', 'PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPEG, JPG, PNG, XLS or XLSX', 'up to a maximum of 15 files' and 'ZIP files are not allowed for security reasons'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 2; repo:frontend src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents)

On a germinal products notification, a document added with the reference 'ITAHC-001', a document type, a date of issue and a PDF file is listed with a 'Scanning for virus' tag and then a 'Check completed' tag, its 'View file' link downloads the file that was attached, and it is still listed after the page is reloaded. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:prototype-dr2-1 TRACE C actions 92-95)

On a germinal products notification, 'Save and add another' with nothing entered shows an error summary titled 'There is a problem' listing, in order, 'Enter a document reference', 'Select a document type', 'Enter a date of issue' and 'Upload a document', each repeated inline on its own field. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:animals-fit p22-068)

On a germinal products notification, Remove takes a listed document off the page straight away with no confirmation, and it is not listed after the page is reloaded. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:animals-fit p22-058)

A document added on a germinal products notification is not listed on any live animals notification's Upload documents page, and a germinal products notification cannot be opened through the live animals set's Upload documents page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 4, 6)

The germinal products Upload documents page has no serious or critical axe violations (WCAG 2.2 AA) when empty, in its error state and with a saved document that has scanned clean. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 15)

sources.ref: p1-092, p2-051 (the documents theme stands as distilled)
p1-024 (names only live animals and high-risk plants)
§Germinal Data Elements (p4-075, p4-084, p4-093, p4-101, p4-104: no germinal-specific document fields)

notes: One slice only; nothing to combine. Every other requirement this area still has to build is held by a theme already split off (req-497, req-538, req-539, req-542 and req-2179 by documents; req-505 by design-snagging; req-543 by type-question-and-templates), so this area's only row is the germinal copy.

Keeps its theme, germinal-products, and its existing id inc-179. The backend's accompanying-document endpoints are keyed by notification reference and need no change for a germinal notification, so backend is not in repos. The end-to-end, accessibility and security specs sit under the tests repo's animals project in the germinal-products folders, with page objects beside the other germinal page objects; the security spec drives the germinal documents routes through the ZAP scan. Criteria assert the page by heading, copy and destination, never by a literal path. Plants mapping: a straight copy within animals, no plants change (plants-common-mapping-2026-10-09.json inc-179).

Ordering correction, 25 November: the row's externalDependsOn must name the documents split workarea's rows that actually landed the live animals documents changes, which are now inc-031, inc-034, inc-037 and inc-038, all done. The two ids it carries today, inc-033 and inc-035, are merged-into, a withheld status that never becomes done, so the row as it stands could never be picked up: inc-033's document-type half became inc-037 and inc-035's scan half became inc-038. Keep inc-031 and inc-034, replace inc-033 with inc-037 and inc-035 with inc-038, and keep dependsOn inc-176 plus the germinal set's own rows for the overview and category scoping as the combiner places them.

The 50MB row (documents inc-036) was dropped on 26 October because the limit is already live: the page's own limit is 50MB and its Attachment hint states it, so nothing is waited on and the copy carries the limit as the fourth criterion states.

The open question this row carried, whether the rule that Save and return to overview makes exactly the same checks as Save and continue reaches the germinal set, is settled and removed: it was ruled for every page (conflict c-339, req-2162), it is already built on the live animals page (design-snagging-followups inc-232, done), and the set-wide proof belongs to the row that owns both save buttons across every germinal page (inc-244). So this row carries no save-button criterion, and nothing is left undecided here.

The live animals documents page is signed off (maturity agreed). This row adds a new page in a new set and changes nothing inside the live animals documents feature folder, so the signed-off check should not trip. If the plan finds the copy cannot be taken without editing that folder, stop and raise it rather than editing it.

Design snagging merged to main on 23 October, so the live Upload documents page this row copies has already changed: the File upload card is full width with the fields and drop zone in a two-thirds column inside it, there is no empty-state line, the action column is right-aligned, the date example hint is one shared copy key and the date picker is the house calendar, Welsh has its own file-type list joining, and refusals and save fallbacks are logged. The germinal copy takes these as they are.
Trimmed 6 November: its navigation (where Save and continue and Back go, the opening run, amend returns) was taken out; EUDPA-774 owns it.
